content.user_title: Create precise TikZJax diagrams in Obsidian
content.value_statement: Complex diagrams are hard to describe with simple note tools. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create TikZJax diagrams for Obsidian.
actual_capabilities: Provides the required TikZJax document structure for Obsidian code blocks.
Guides package selection for tikz-cd, circuitikz, pgfplots, chemfig, and tikz-3dplot.
Creates examples for rectangles, coordinate systems, circuits, chemical structures, commutative diagrams, and 3D plots.
Explains dark mode behavior for text color, black and white inversion, and custom colors.
Documents TikZ libraries, node positioning, line styles, coordinate syntax, and common diagram patterns.
Helps choose TikZJax when Mermaid, Desmos, or MathJax are less suitable.
limitations: Requires the Obsidian TikZJax plugin to render diagrams.
Does not compile or visually validate diagrams inside the skill report.
Some TikZJax features are unsupported, including color mixing and Korean text.
Custom colors created with definecolor may not adapt to dark mode.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technical Notes
use_cases.description: Create precise diagrams for geometry, coordinate systems, and annotated technical notes.

use_cases.title: Draft Engineering Figures
use_cases.description: Generate circuit diagrams, labeled components, and readable layouts using circuitikz guidance.

use_cases.title: Build Research Visuals
use_cases.description: Create commutative diagrams, chemical structures, and 3D plots for teaching or documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Shape
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TikZJax diagram for Obsidian showing a labeled rectangle with a colored content area. Include the required document structure.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Coordinate Diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TikZJax coordinate system with labeled axes, one plotted point, dashed guide lines, and theme-safe label colors.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Technical Diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TikZJax circuit diagram using circuitikz for a resistor, capacitor, battery, and closed loop. Keep labels readable in Obsidian.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Package Figure
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an advanced TikZJax figure for Obsidian using pgfplots or tikz-3dplot. Explain required packages and dark mode considerations.

output_examples.input: A math note needs a coordinate plane with a labeled point and guide lines.
output_examples.output: A TikZJax-ready diagram with axes, point P, dashed guides, and theme-aware labels.

output_examples.input: An electronics note needs a simple RC circuit diagram.
output_examples.output: A circuitikz-based figure with resistor, capacitor, battery, closed loop, and readable component labels.

output_examples.input: A research note needs a 3D surface plot for a Gaussian function.
output_examples.output: A pgfplots figure plan with package requirements, viewing angle, surface plot settings, and Obsidian rendering notes.

best_practices: Describe the diagram purpose, labels, shapes, and approximate layout before asking for TikZJax output.
Use named colors and avoid fixed text colors when notes must work in both light and dark themes.
Ask for required packages and libraries when using circuits, plots, chemistry, or commutative diagrams.
anti_patterns: Do not use TikZJax for simple flowcharts when Mermaid is easier to maintain.
Do not rely on unsupported color mixing when the diagram must render in TikZJax.
Do not omit the required document structure for Obsidian TikZJax blocks.

faq.question: Does this skill render diagrams itself?
faq.answer: No. It helps create TikZJax source for Obsidian. Rendering depends on Obsidian and the TikZJax plugin.

faq.question: Can it create Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: It focuses on TikZJax. The skill recommends Mermaid for flowcharts, sequences, and ER diagrams when precision is less important.

faq.question: Does it support dark mode?
faq.answer: It guides color choices that work with TikZJax dark mode inversion. Black and white may invert based on plugin settings.

faq.question: Can it generate circuit or chemistry diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for circuitikz and chemfig, plus package notes for each diagram type.

faq.question: What should I provide in a prompt?
faq.answer: Describe the diagram goal, labels, shapes, relative positions, colors, and any packages you expect to use.

faq.question: Can it use custom colors?
faq.answer: Yes, but custom colors may not adapt to dark mode. The reference also notes unsupported color mixing.
